brief: A two-storey storage tower for a workbench with at least two drawers.

requirements.evidence: 4x full base pieces forming 2 columns (q0,0 and q1,0) across level 0 and level 1 with vertical snaps: piece:0,0,0;full + piece:0,0,1;full and piece:1,0,0;full + piece:1,0,1;full

4x notch drawer frames installed in the gaps between the columns: notch:0#0,1#notch1 and notch:0#1,-1#notch4 on level 0 plus notch:1#0,1#notch1 and notch:1#1,-1#notch4 on level 1 – exceeds minimum of two

finish.summary: Built a compact 2-high tower on two adjacent cells (0,0 and 1,0) both levels 0-1, providing storage volume, and fitted four notch drawer frames (two per storey) in the interstitial positions to satisfy the drawer requirement.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
